title: Text 2
subtitle: 网络新闻可信度与年轻一代的媒介素养

sentences.en: A new survey by Harvard University finds more than two-thirds of young Americans disapprove of President Trump's use of Twitter.
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学的一项新调查发现，超过三分之二的美国年轻人不赞成特朗普总统使用推特。

sentences.en: The implication is that Millennials prefer news from the White House to be filtered through other sources, not a president's social media platform.
sentences.zh: 这意味着千禧一代更希望白宫发布的消息经过其他来源过滤，而非直接来自总统的社交媒体平台。

sentences.en: Most Americans rely on social media to check daily headlines.
sentences.zh: 大多数美国人依赖社交媒体浏览每日头条新闻。

sentences.en: Yet as distrust has risen toward all media, people may be starting to beef up their media literacy skills.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着人们对所有媒体的不信任感上升，人们可能开始提升自己的媒介素养。

sentences.en: Such a trend is badly needed.
sentences.zh: 这种趋势亟需出现。

sentences.en: During the 2016 presidential campaign, nearly a quarter of web content shared by Twitter users in the politically critical state of Michigan was fake news, according to the University of Oxford.
sentences.zh: 据牛津大学统计，在2016年总统竞选期间，政治立场举足轻重的密歇根州的推特用户所分享的网络内容中，近四分之一是假新闻。

sentences.en: And a survey conducted for BuzzFeed News found 44 percent of Facebook users rarely or never trust news from the media giant.
sentences.zh: 而为BuzzFeed News进行的一项调查发现，44%的脸书用户很少或从不信任这家媒体巨头的新闻。

sentences.en: Young people who are digital natives are indeed becoming more skillful at separating fact from fiction in cyberspace.
sentences.zh: 作为数字原住民的年轻人确实越来越善于在网络空间分辨真伪。

sentences.en: A Knight Foundation focus-group survey of young people between ages 14 and 24 found they use "distributed trust" to verify stories.
sentences.zh: 奈特基金会针对14至24岁年轻人开展的一项焦点小组调查发现，他们利用“分布式信任”来核实新闻报道。

sentences.en: They cross-check sources and prefer news from different perspectives — especially those that are open about any bias.
sentences.zh: 他们会交叉核对信息来源，偏好来自不同视角的新闻——尤其是那些坦承自身偏见倾向的新闻。

sentences.en: "Many young people assume a great deal of personal responsibility for educating themselves and actively seeking out opposing viewpoints," the survey concluded.
sentences.zh: 该调查总结道：“许多年轻人在自我教育、主动寻找对立观点方面承担了相当大的个人责任。”

sentences.en: Such active research can have another effect.
sentences.zh: 这种积极的探究还能产生另一种影响。

sentences.en: A 2014 survey conducted in Australia, Britain, and the United States by the University of Wisconsin-Madison found that young people's reliance on social media led to greater political engagement.
sentences.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校2014年在澳大利亚、英国和美国开展的一项调查发现，年轻人对社交媒体的依赖促进了他们更广泛的政治参与。

sentences.en: Social media allows users to experience news events more intimately and immediately while also permitting them to re-share news as a projection of their values and interests.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体让用户更贴近、更即时地体验新闻事件，同时也允许他们转发新闻，以投射自己的价值观和兴趣。

sentences.en: This forces users to be more conscious of their role in passing along information.
sentences.zh: 这迫使用户更加意识到自己在传递信息中所扮演的角色。

sentences.en: A survey by Barna research group found the top reason given by Americans for the fake news phenomenon is "reader error," more so than made-up stories or factual mistakes in reporting.
sentences.zh: 巴纳研究小组的一项调查发现，美国人认为假新闻现象的首要原因是“读者错误”，而非凭空捏造的故事或报道中的事实错误。

sentences.en: About a third say the problem of fake news lies in "misinterpretation or exaggeration of actual news" via social media.
sentences.zh: 约三分之一的人认为，假新闻的问题在于通过社交媒体“对真实新闻的曲解或夸大”。

sentences.en: In other words, the choice to share news on social media may be the heart of the issue.
sentences.zh: 换言之，是否选择在社交媒体上分享新闻可能才是问题的核心。

sentences.en: "This indicates there is a real personal responsibility in counteracting this problem," says Roxanne Stone, editor in chief at Barna Group.
sentences.zh: 巴纳集团主编罗克珊·斯通表示：“这表明，在遏制这一问题上，个人确实负有责任。”

sentences.en: So when young people are critical of an over-tweeting president, they reveal a mental discipline in thinking skills — and in their choices on when to share on social media.
sentences.zh: 因此，当年轻人对一位过度发推特的总统提出批评时，他们展现出的是一种思维技能上的心智自律——以及他们在选择何时在社交媒体上分享内容时的自律。

questions.stem: According to the Paragraphs 1 and 2, many young Americans cast doubts on ____

options.A: the justification of the news-filtering practice.
options.B: people’s preference for social media platforms.
options.C: the administration’s ability to handle information.
options.D: social media was a reliable source of news.

questions.analysis: 双段推理题。根据题目定位到第1段和第2段，双段推理优先考虑双段主旨。第一段中心句为最后一句话：Millennials prefer news from the White House to be filtered through other sources， not a president’s social media platform。“千禧一代喜欢白宫直接发布的消息…而不是总统社交媒体发布的信息”，说明他们不太信任社交媒体。第2段中心为第二句转折之后，说明对于社交媒体的不信任上升。故双段中心都和他们不信任社交媒体相关。结合以上信息，得出社交媒体信息不可靠，选择D。

questions.stem: The phrase “beef up” (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ____
questions.analysis: 词汇释义题。根据题目定位到第2段第2句：Yet as distrust has risen toward all media，people may be starting to beef up their media literacy skills。句子的情感色彩判断，因为逗号前提到“人们对于所有媒体的不信任增加”，可以推知人们应该开始增强其媒体素养的技能，故选A。

questions.stem: According to the Knight Foundation survey, young people ____

options.A: tend to voice their opinions in cyberspace.
options.B: verify news by referring to diverse sources.
options.C: have a strong sense of social responsibility.
options.D: like to exchange views on “distributed trust”.

questions.analysis: 范例证明题。根据题干定位至第三段第二句话。因为某项研究一般是论据证明前面的论点，故答案应该位于第一句话“Young people who are digital natives are indeed becoming more skillful at seperating fact from fiction in cyberspace。” 说明答案应该“和年轻人更容易把网络中的事实和虚假信息区分开来”，故答案为B“验证新闻的真伪”。为了精确可以在论据中去验证，论据中提到“verify stories”， “cross check sources”和“prefer news from different perspectives”，都是和多重角度验证信息真伪相关的。

questions.stem: The Barna survey found that a main cause for the fake news problem is ____
questions.analysis: 事实细节题。根据题干定位至第五段第三句found之后a main reason对应the top reason，而原文剩余信息为“reader error”， 所以应该和读者相关。Error应该对应misinterpretation， 故答案为C readers’ misinterpretation。若本句不清晰，下句进一步说明答案的内容，文中misintepretation or exerggeration of actual news进一步印证C为正确答案。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?

options.A: A Rise in Critical Skills for Sharing News Online
options.B: A Counteraction Against the Over-tweeting Trend
options.C: The Accumulation of Mutual Trust on Social Media
options.D: The Platforms for Projection of Personal Interests

questions.analysis: 全文主旨题。本篇文章属于篇首转折，二段转折之后为全文主旨，yet之后说道：“Yet as distrust has risen toward all media， people may be strarting to beef up their media literacy skills”。“随着对于所有媒体不信任的上升，人们开始增强其媒体素养的技能”，故答案为A。为了验证，可以看篇末，篇末重申主题，so之后讲道“so when young people are critical of an over-tweeting president， they reaveal a mental discipline in thinking skills-and in their choices on when to share on social media。” 更进一步说明和人们批判性看待社交媒体上的新闻相关。
